Both filter down to just the javascript links the way I'd want. For hopping between tags over and over, the list beside the bookmarks feels more natural to me — the tags stay put in one place so I can click one, then another, without them moving around. Seeing all my tags with a count next to each is a nice touch, and picking one at a time is fine for how I'd use it.

So I'd go with tags beside the list.
